history.summary: Cassia View is a 72-unit freehold condo (2001) at Guillemard Rd, D14, 560m from Dakota MRT — 3BR 1,205 sqft at $1.949M / $1,617 psf, just below the $1,650 median. Freehold, sub-$2M quantum near MRT and a high ~6.3% URA rate are appealing, though the rate rests on only 14 transactions.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, $1.949M (in the liquid band), $1,617 psf below the $1,650 median, and 560m from Dakota MRT (Circle Line) is a strong combination. URA resale CAGR is ~6.3% — encouraging, though the 14-txn base means treat as indicative, not certain. At 72 units it has modest but real en-bloc optionality (appears on en-bloc-potential lists) given freehold status and age. D14/Paya Lebar Central transformation supports demand. A solid value-buy; I trim the rate for the thin sample.
red_flags: URA rate ~6.3% rests on only 14 transactions — indicative, not statistically firm
2001 build — older property, higher maintenance and some resale age discount
72-unit development — moderate, not deep, liquidity; en-bloc is optionality not a plan
catalysts: Freehold below district median PSF, $1.949M in the liquid band
Paya Lebar Central commercial transformation lifts D14 demand
Freehold + 2001 age gives genuine en-bloc optionality (72 units)
